section: Science (Paper-2) · Ch — Nutrition & Food Components — Deep 4
subject: Science
stem: A person deprived of adequate protein intake over a long period may develop weakened immunity, muscle wasting, and slowed growth in children. Which food group would MOST directly address this deficiency?

options.option_text: Pulses, milk, eggs, and meat (protein-rich foods)

explanation: Protein-rich foods (pulses, milk, eggs, meat) are needed to rebuild tissue, support immunity, and enable growth — correcting protein deficiency symptoms like muscle wasting and stunted growth.
